messages:
maya: Quick plan for next-week social push  lightweight launch focused on dev audience. We want 2 X threads (short tech thread + benchmark thread) and 1 LinkedIn long post. Need copy + hero GIF by Thu EOD.

sam: Timeline sounds good. Suggest timezone stagger: NA morning, EU afternoon, APAC evening. Keep hooks variable per region.

lina: CTA matrix: NA -> sandbox signups, EU -> case study download, APAC -> webinar RSVP. Ill draft LinkedIn and alt hooks.

ana: I can make a snappy 3-frame GIF + two static hero images by Thu afternoon. Send me the final benchmark stat to include.

devon: Ill handle UTMs and Zap routing. Proposed utm_campaign=launch-mini-175333, utm_medium=social, utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_content={na|eu|apac}, cv={gif_a|gif_b}. Map webinar leads -> sdr-na@redwood, case study -> nurture-sales.

sam: We should prepare 4 alt hooks (two tech-forward, two value-forward) so we can swap quickly based on early engagement. Ill write them.

maya: Engagement fallback: if <180 interactions in 24h, auto-boost best-performing node ($350) and re-post a variant after 16h. ops-bot, please add an alert for campaign id "launch-mini-175333".

ops-bot: Alert created for campaign "launch-mini-175333": threshold=180 interactions in 24h. Notifying @maya @sam @lina on trigger.

lina: Drafts uploaded: https://drive.google.com/launch-mini-drafts. Added alt hooks and a compact data visual for X.

ana: Uploading initial GIF v1 to the shared drive in an hour. Will label as gif_v1 and gif_v2 for quick swap.

devon: Zap setup in progress. Confirming form fields mapping and UTM appenders. Will finish Thu EOD.

maya: Checklist: copy (lina) Wed EOD, assets (ana) Thu EOD, UTM & zap (devon) Thu EOD, queue posts Fri AM. Everyone keep alt hooks ready. :rocket:
